title: Wallet
subtitle: Your personal wallet for crypto trading
exchangeHelp: If you don't have an exchange account yet, we recommend Binance. You can later connect your account here to see everything in one place.

security.title: Security first
security.readOnly: We only request read-only API keys. This means we can read balances and transactions, but NEVER execute trades or withdrawals.
security.warning: Never share API keys with write access (write/trade/withdraw).
security.commission: We receive a small commission from Binance at no extra cost to you. This helps us keep the service free.
